[Section] Our Systems and Their Performance on Factoid Questions ::: Impact of Using Context from URLs (negative)
[source_id=71] In some experiments, for context in testing, we used documents for which URL pointers are provided in BioAsq. However, our system UNCC_QA3 underperformed our other system tested only on the provided snippets.
[source_id=72] In Batch 5 the underperformance was about 6% of MRR, compared to our best system UNCC_QA1, and by 9% to the top performer.
